name: Blazing Cartesia, the Virtuous
card_text: If you have "Fallen of Albaz" in your field or GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 Level 8 or higher Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. During the End Phase, if a Fusion Monster(s) was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from the GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blazing Cartesia, the Virtuous" once per turn.
available_set: THE CHRONICLES DECK: The Fallen & The Virtuous (All-Foil Edition)
25TH ANNIVERSARY TIN: DUELING HEROES MEGA PACK
